UpdateStageName: Validate Freelancer Files and Accept EULA
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "EXE=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}game/EXE/FLServer.exe\"; EULA=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}game/EBUEula.dll\"; if [ ! -f \"$EXE\" ]; then echo \"Freelancer server files are missing: $EXE\" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f \"$EULA\" ]; then echo \"Freelancer EULA library is missing: $EULA\" >&2; exit 1; fi; B=$(od -An -tx1 -j $((0x217d)) -N 1 \"$EULA\" | tr -d '[:space:]'); case \"$B\" in 00) printf '\\001' | dd of=\"$EULA\" bs=1 seek=$((0x217d)) conv=notrunc status=none || exit 1 ;; 01) : ;; *) echo \"Unexpected EBUEula.dll byte at 0x217D: $B\" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac"
